checkpoints.question: Two of your courses have different AI rules. Which rule applies to an essay?
options: The policy of the course the essay is for
checkpoints.explain: Integrity means following the rules of the course you are in.

checkpoints.question: Which disclosure is most useful to an instructor?
options: I used a chatbot to brainstorm; I kept two ideas, rewrote them and checked them against the readings.
checkpoints.explain: Say what tool, for what, and what you did with the output.
